# hush_agw_consent_methods (Data Source)

The consent methods a deployment's agent gateway may prompt a user through, when a tool call needs the user's consent.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hush_agw_consent_methods" "gateway" {
  deployment_id = hush_deployment.gateway.id
}

output "gateway_consent_methods" {
  value = data.hush_agw_consent_methods.gateway.methods
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `deployment_id` (String) The deployment whose gateway's methods to read.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `method` (List of Object) Each method with how it prompts the user, as Hush describes it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--method))
- `methods` (Set of String) The methods allowed, such as 'oidc_callback' and 'push_slack'. Empty when none were ever set for the deployment.

<a id="nestedatt--method"></a>
### Nested Schema for `method`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String)
- `name` (String)
